name: NG exhaustion chain-birth V2 brain proposal
purpose: Refine the entry-timing proposal around the executable question of chain birth: identify the earliest causal point at which the next exhaustion-chain stage can be predicted to begin, prefer PRIOR prediction before target onset, and use detector-relative timing only as fallback recognition when PRIOR fails.

proposal_lessons.lesson: For entry timing, the primary target is whether the chain extends to the next D-stage, conditional on having reached D-1. The full future behavior vector of a stage is secondary and should be analyzed only after birth timing is established.
proposal_lessons.do_not_learn: Do not condition the primary timing model on a target stage already being known to exist and then call that pre-birth prediction.

proposal_lessons.lesson: Exhaust PRIOR prediction before using the detector-relative fallback ladder. At active predecessor-information H, a stage is prior-eligible only when every required predecessor detector-confirmation plus H is no later than target t0. The earliest chronologically/OOT validated PRIOR signal wins.
proposal_lessons.do_not_learn: Do not delay a valid PRIOR birth call to +0 or a later checkpoint merely because later recognition is cleaner.

proposal_lessons.lesson: Only rules/subfamilies that fail PRIOR prediction enter the fallback ladder: target detector confirmation +0, then +1/+2/+3/+4/+5/+10/+15/+20/+25 and every 5 seconds thereafter through +3600 while structurally alive. These are recognition times, not pre-birth predictions.
proposal_lessons.do_not_learn: Do not relabel target detection or post-detection survival as prediction of the beginning.

proposal_lessons.lesson: For stage D, compare chains that extend to depth >= D against frozen exact-(D-1) stops. Use the frozen lineage to create real controls; do not synthesize negative cases.

Each predecessor exhaustion occurrence carries its own separate causal one-second price path. At H, the model sees the full integer-second path from 1 through H for each predecessor, in chain order, relative to the last authoritative trade known at or before that predecessor detector-confirmation time.
proposal_lessons.encoding: one signed cumulative price value per second aligned to occurrence polarity; adjacent differences recover one-second changes
proposal_lessons.causal_rule: second s uses only the last trade known by detector_confirmation+s; carry forward the last already-known price if no new trade occurs; never interpolate from future tape
proposal_lessons.do_not_learn: Do not collapse multiple predecessor occurrences into one generic chain price path.

proposal_lessons.lesson: Raw price structure availability is infrastructure, not a predictive feature. The workflow must fail closed if authoritative raw tape or a causal baseline is missing; once integrity passes, missingness or availability may not distinguish births from stops.
proposal_lessons.do_not_learn: Do not use price_structure_available, missingness, or data-completeness differences as model signals.

proposal_lessons.lesson: PRIOR birth prediction must preserve the settled Phase-1 characteristics wall. Timing may establish availability and lead only; target identity/polarity/state, future-revealing predecessor link fields, final depth/duration, future path shape, family, post-state, flow, book, time-of-day, session position, and pre-exhaustion shape are excluded from the birth model.
proposal_lessons.do_not_learn: Do not let retrospective target or final-chain information enter an earlier birth prediction.

proposal_lessons.lesson: Substantial PRIOR windows exist for D1-D3 and several D4/D5 cases, but causal availability is not predictive skill. A stage becomes a candidate only after chronological/OOT predictive validation against frozen stop controls.

A partial structural clue that fails the predeclared validation gate remains research memory, not a promoted timing rule. The current D2 H=1 polarity-only probe is an explicit example: extra trees passed but logistic and KNN failed, so the required 2-of-3 gate was not met.

For every validated PRIOR birth signal, trade research starts from the exact causal RULE_READY timestamp. Attach direction/behavior evidence and raw-tape economics from that timestamp, then measure fill, remaining runway, MFE, MAE, displacement, path efficiency/chop, costs, and candidate exits. Use fallback recognition timing only for PRIOR failures.
proposal_lessons.do_not_learn: Do not optimize a strategy from a timestamp that was not causally knowable live.

settled_protocol: dense H grid 1/2/3/4/5/10/15 then every 5 seconds through 3600
current_findings_boundary.explicit_nonfinding: D2 H=1 polarity-only does not pass the required 2-of-3 gate
pending: earliest validated V2 PRIOR H for D1
earliest validated V2 PRIOR H for D2
earliest validated V2 PRIOR H for D3
D4/D5 individual case timing with price paths
exact-signal-time trade economics and strategy proposals

promotion_boundary.requirement: Any chain-birth timing or trade strategy remains proposal/historical research until a predeclared fresh prospective/OOT promotion contract is passed.

do_not_learn: Do not treat availability as predictive skill.
Do not treat +0 or post-detection recognition as pre-birth prediction.
Do not replace an earlier validated PRIOR signal with a later cleaner checkpoint.
Do not use realized final depth, final duration, future target identity, or future path at an earlier H.
Do not collapse multiple predecessor price paths into one generic availability flag.
Do not use raw-tape missingness as a birth feature.
Do not promote the failed D2 H=1 polarity-only clue.
Do not infer a universal D4/D5 law from current support.
Do not merge this proposal into permanent Frankie without deliberate adjudication with all parent proposal layers.
